div.div: Because A starts first, B can only begin inside A or after it. There is no third possibility — and that is the whole algorithm.

div.div: Sorting is the algorithm. Unsorted, a new meeting could clash with anything — O(N²). Sorted, it can only clash with its immediate predecessor.
